_comment: Curated editorial collections (e.g. 'Dog-friendly patios', 'Best sunset spots').
ASCII-only. Edit by hand; collections.py reads this at request time (cached).
slug:    URL slug, lowercase kebab-case (required, unique).
accent:  optional pill/body accent: warm / fresh / water / neutral (default neutral).
places:  list of place entries; reuses the curated_discover entry schema where possible:
slug:        optional Provider.slug; when present, card links to /provider/<slug>.
image_url:   full Unsplash URL with sizing params (optional).
meta_line:   short meta line below name (optional).
Acceptance: 2-3 collections, each with a handful of place entries.

collections.title: Dog-friendly patios
collections.blurb: Where you can post up with a cold drink and your dog at your feet. Water bowls usually on the house.

places.name: Barley Brothers
places.blurb: Bridge-view patio with room for the dog to sprawl.

places.name: Mudshark Brewing
places.blurb: Shaded outdoor tables, easy with a leash.

places.name: Javelina Cantina
places.blurb: Margaritas on the patio, dogs welcome at the rail.

collections.title: Best sunset spots
collections.blurb: Where locals go when the light turns gold. Free, scenic, and worth the short drive.

places.name: London Bridge
places.blurb: The channel water glows under the arches at dusk.

places.name: Body Beach
places.blurb: Wide-open western view straight down the lake.

places.name: Site Six
places.blurb: Watch the boats come in as the sky lights up.

collections.title: On-the-water classics
collections.blurb: The launches, beaches, and coves that make a Havasu weekend.

places.name: Lake Havasu State Park
places.blurb: Beaches, ramada, and boat ramps in one spot.

places.name: Cattail Cove
places.blurb: Quieter cove with camping right on the shore.
